how.heading: How the dailies work
how.puzzlesBody: Each day brings a quick mini, a 9×9 midi and a full 15×15 large — original crosswords, free, with no account needed. New puzzles arrive at midnight.
how.modesBody: Play against the clock on your own, or start a room, share the code and fill the same grid together. Correct letters lock in as they're claimed, so the fastest solver wins.
how.progressBody: Every finish goes on that puzzle's board for the day, and solving on consecutive days builds a streak. Past puzzles keeps recent days open; sign in to reach further back.
